newsitem.title: INDIA: India zinc falls back, other base metals ranged.
newsitem.headline: India zinc falls back, other base metals ranged.

text.p: Zinc prices suffered a setback at the improved level on the local market on Wednesday but other base metals were steady in a narrow trading range in limited activity, dealers said.
Zinc prices slid by 50 rupees at 8,050 rupees per quintal on demand resistance at the higher level while fresh arrivals of imported metals prompted profit-taking.
Copper was steady at 13,700 rupees per quintal after losing 50 rupees on Tuesday.
"We are witnessing increased physical enquiries for copper and local prices may move up gradually in the coming days," said Sharad Parikh, president of the Bombay Metals Exchange.
Nickel was quiet at 36,400 rupees per quintal as selling pressure reduced at the lower level following reports of a recovery in the world market. Nickel was down by 200 rupees per quintal on Tuesday.
Tin was quiet at 31,200 rupees per quintal, as was lead at 4,100 rupees per quintal and aluminium at 7,700 rupees per quintal in limited activity.
Market sentiment for aluminium remained firm on expectations that local producers might hike prices.
